hook: Most American millionaires are not buying what you think. Researchers found that many of them never paid more than $399 for a suit and drive ordinary cars for years. In this video I go through 20 things rich people never buy, from three angles: the numbers behind each purchase, the psychology that makes the rest of us buy them, and the playbook for what to do instead.
shorts: Most millionaires never paid more than $399 for a suit
The lottery odds nobody thinks about
Would you buy it if nobody could see it?
